description_en: Calls the published Computer Use Agent (CUA) Standard Edition, submits a task and the current desktop screenshot, and returns single-step computer operation decisions by using Server-Sent Events (SSE). After the client executes the computer_use action, it returns the actual results and continues the call with the session ID and the latest screenshot
description_zh: 调用已发布的 Computer Use Agent（CUA）标准版，提交任务和当前桌面截图，以 SSE 返回单步电脑操作决策。客户端执行 `computer_use` 动作后回传真实结果，并携带会话 ID 和最新截图继续调用
name: CuaChatCompletionStream

parameters.help_en: The instance access key, which must match the instance. According to the original materials, the original qis_ key or Bearer format can be passed. It cannot replace the POP AK signature
parameters.help_zh: 实例访问密钥，须与实例匹配；按原资料可传原始 qis_ 密钥或 Bearer 形式，不能替代 POP AK 签名
parameters.name: x_qi_agent_api_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target published CUA standard instance
parameters.help_zh: 目标已发布 CUA 标准版实例 ID
parameters.name: x_qi_instance_id

parameters.help_en: Can be omitted in the first round. In subsequent rounds, reuse the qi_session_id returned in the body
parameters.help_zh: 首轮可省略；续轮复用正文返回的 qi_session_id
parameters.name: x_qi_session_id

parameters.help_en: It is recommended to explicitly generate this ID. Reuse it for retries of the same step, and use a new ID for a new step
parameters.help_zh: 建议显式生成；同一步重试复用，新一步换新ID
parameters.name: x_qi_request_id

fields.help_en: The compatible inline screenshot field for input_image. Use a complete Base64 image data URL. Raw Base64 without a prefix is not accepted
fields.help_zh: input_image 兼容字段，使用完整 Data URL，不接受无前缀 Base64
fields.name: image_data

fields.help_en: An accessible HTTP(S) URL or a complete image data URL. HTTPS is recommended
fields.help_zh: 可访问 HTTP(S) URL 或完整图片 Data URL；推荐 HTTPS
fields.name: url

fields.help_en: The screenshot reference. The URL object format is recommended. The backend is also compatible with image_url strings
fields.help_zh: 截图引用；推荐 url 对象形式，后端也兼容 image_url 字符串
fields.name: image_url

fields.example: 观察桌面，打开浏览器并找到设置页面
fields.help_en: The text content. In the first round, the user must provide a non-empty task objective. For tool, use the actual execution result
fields.help_zh: 首轮非空任务目标；tool 使用真实执行结果
fields.name: text

fields.help_en: The type of the content item. For text, use text or input_text. For screenshots, use image_url or input_image
fields.help_zh: 文本为 text/input_text，截图为 image_url/input_image
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: For user, a multimodal array is used. For tool, an array of text content items can be used to return execution results. The backend is also compatible with non-empty strings or objects
fields.help_zh: user 使用多模态数组；tool 支持文本项数组、非空字符串或对象
fields.name: content

fields.help_en: The role of the message. Only user or tool is supported. In the first round, use user. In subsequent rounds, the sequence is tool and then user
fields.help_zh: 仅 user/tool；不传 system、assistant 或完整历史
fields.name: role

fields.help_en: Required when role is tool. It must be equal to the computer_use call ID returned in the previous step of the same session
fields.help_zh: role=tool 时必填，必须等于同 session 上一步 computer_use 调用 ID
fields.name: tool_call_id

parameters.help_en: Required. In the first round, only one user message is included. In subsequent rounds, only one tool message followed by one user message is included. Exactly one screenshot is included per step
parameters.help_zh: 首轮仅一条 user；续轮仅一条 tool 后接一条 user；每步恰好一张截图
parameters.name: messages

fields.help_en: The action mode. Valid values: gui-only or gui+cli. This parameter is case-sensitive and remains fixed within a session. Supplemented by subsequent service instructions
fields.help_zh: gui-only 或 gui+cli，大小写敏感，session 内固定；后续服务说明补充
fields.name: action_mode

fields.help_en: The pixel height of the uploaded screenshot. If provided, it must be a positive integer
fields.help_zh: 上传截图像素高度，提供时为正整数
fields.name: screen_height

fields.help_en: The pixel width of the uploaded screenshot. If provided, it must be a positive integer
fields.help_zh: 上传截图像素宽度，提供时为正整数
fields.name: screen_width

parameters.help_en: The auxiliary information for the current screenshot and the running modes supported by the service instructions
parameters.help_zh: 当前截图辅助信息及服务说明支持的运行模式
parameters.name: metadata

parameters.help_en: A compatible field. It can be omitted or set to an empty string. The actual model is determined by the instance or the model catalog configured for debugging, and is not routed based on this field
parameters.help_zh: 可省略或传 ""，实际模型由实例决定
parameters.name: model

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable streaming. Set this parameter to true for this SSE API
parameters.name: stream

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to return an independent usage event before the end marker. If set to true, an independent usage event is returned, and choices is an empty array
fields.help_zh: 为 true 时返回独立 usage 事件
fields.name: include_usage

parameters.help_en: Can only be omitted or set to an empty array. CUA uses the fixed computer_use tool and does not allow custom tools
parameters.help_zh: 只能省略或传 []，不允许自定义工具
parameters.name: tools

schema.description_en: The SSE streaming response metadata. Business data is returned as chat.completion.chunk events and ultimately ends with data:[DONE]. For complete field descriptions, see the supplementary instructions for response parameters
schema.description_zh: SSE 流式响应元数据。业务数据按 chat.completion.chunk 事件返回，最终以 data:[DONE] 结束；完整字段说明见返回参数补充说明

requestId.description_en: The POP gateway request ID for gateway tracking. It is not the qi_request_id of the agent and cannot replace reading the SSE body
requestId.description_zh: POP 网关请求标识，供网关追踪；不是 Agent 的 qi_request_id，不能代替读取 SSE 正文

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The input for the current step of CUA. In the first round, it is the task text and a screenshot. In subsequent rounds, it is the tool receipt of the previous action and a new screenshot. Complete history is not accepted
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: CUA 当前一步输入：首轮为任务文本和一张截图；续轮为上一动作的 tool 回执和一张新截图，不接受完整历史
v1_body_parameters.name: body
